derivation:
constructor
  · intro h; have := congrArg (quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient I hI) h; simpa [quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient, quotientInfToPiQuotient_mk] using congrFun this
  · intro h; apply (quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient I hI).injective; simpa [quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient, quotientInfToPiQuotient_mk] using (funext h).symm
explanation: Mathlib defines the Chinese-remainder ring equivalence using `quotientInfToPiQuotient`, whose value on a quotient representative is given by `quotientInfToPiQuotient_mk`. Applying the equivalence to the inverse-side equality, or using its injectivity in the converse, reduces the claim to equality of the coordinates. The target proof instead rewrites to the library's pairwise-sup version.
